action.description: Choose one action and provide exactly its matching object; omit the other action objects.

project_path.description: Verified absolute root of the project being worked on, not Agentlaw's process cwd. Required for connect_project_memory; supported for recall and new/continued remember_this work.

project_hint.description: recall only. Observed name or description of a different project to query; this does not rebind the current folder.

selected_project_id.description: recall only. Copy a project candidate ID and repeat the same project_hint.

machine_id.description: recall only. Copy a known machine ID for explicit cross-machine lookup; omission uses the installation environment.

recall_for.description: For recall, describe the current task/question and new observations; omit for ID-only lookup. For connect_project_memory, supply together with restore_context=true to recall after connecting.

items.description: Use known literal terms such as commands, paths, names, or error messages; these are search clues, not returned IDs.

search_terms.description: recall only. Optional literal search clues such as known commands, paths, names or error messages; use with recall_for.

items.description: Copy a returned identity; do not invent one.

memory_ids.description: recall only. Retrieve complete current memories by known returned IDs; omit recall_for for ID-only lookup.

items.description: Copy a returned identity; do not invent one.

procedure_ids.description: recall only. Retrieve learned procedures by known returned IDs; omit recall_for for ID-only lookup.

restore_context.description: recall or connect_project_memory only. Set true when project context is missing or incomplete. Requires recall_for; omit for ID-only or focused follow-up.

memory_candidate_limit.description: recall only. Positive maximum number of memory candidates to show; omit to use the configured default.

procedure_candidate_limit.description: recall only. Positive maximum number of learned-procedure candidates to show; omit to use the configured default.

path.description: Verified project-relative path. No absolute path or parent traversal.

project_path.description: Verified absolute root of the project being worked on, not Agentlaw's process cwd. Required for connect_project_memory; supported for recall and new/continued remember_this work.

resolution_ref.description: remember_this memory review only. Copy the returned reference unchanged when instructed; do not invent it.

operation.description: create: requires applies_to and no parent/consolidation refs. evolve: requires parent_refs for every current head of one memory, no consolidation_refs. consolidate: requires consolidation_refs for every current head of at least two memories, no parent_refs.

what_to_remember.description: Write the complete, coherent current understanding, preserving applicable conditions and exceptions. When evolving a memory, replace its current text rather than appending a chronological log. For task memory, use Objective / Current position / Resume point / References to capture user intent, the current choice and rationale, verification status, unresolved questions, and the next check. Keep the rationale needed to continue in the task itself; reference independent memories and the Plan without duplicating their full texts.

evidence.description: Record observations, user corrections or decisions, and verification supporting this update. Preserve new occurrences, conditions, and supporting evidence even when the conclusion is unchanged. Distinguish observations from hypotheses.

applies_to.description: For create, choose exactly [user], [project], [machine], or [project, machine]. For evolve/consolidate, omit to inherit applicability or supply the intended scope explicitly.

memory_id.description: Copy memory_id from the returned memory_ref.

observed_version.description: Copy observed_version unchanged. Never compute or guess it.

memory_id.description: Copy memory_id from the returned memory_ref.

observed_version.description: Copy observed_version unchanged. Never compute or guess it.

in_working_set.description: Omit for non-Task memory. For a Task, true means future work must resume it; false means it has completed, been cancelled, or been superseded. Use Objective / Current position / Resume point / References headings exactly once in that order.

is_rule.description: Use true only for explicitly established standing rules; evidence must support that intent.

project_id.description: Copy the target project's known identity.

proposal_id.description: Only copy an existing proposal_id when replacing a retained pending proposal. Omit for a new proposal.

memories.description: remember_this only. Submit one or more complete memory proposals. For initial memory writes this is required; do not combine with procedure. For pending_action=continue, omit unchanged proposals.

observed_version.description: Copy the latest returned pending batch version.

pending_batch_ref.description: remember_this only. Copy the returned pending_batch_id and observed_version together; requires pending_action.

pending_action.description: remember_this retained work only; requires pending_batch_ref. inspect: no other write fields. continue: submit changed memories and/or review_judgments as instructed. discard: requires discard_reason and user_confirmed=true; do not submit edits.

review_ref.description: Copy the review reference for the exact presented dependency state.

review_judgments.description: remember_this with pending_action=continue only. For a dependency that remains valid, copy its returned review_ref and set decision=unchanged. If it needs revision, submit the complete updated memory through memories instead.

discard_reason.description: Required only for remember_this with pending_action=discard. Explain the user-approved reason for discarding retained work.

user_confirmed.description: Set true only after the user confirms discarding a pending batch; use only with pending_action=discard.

observed_version.description: Copy the returned procedure version unchanged.

items.description: Copy a returned identity; do not invent one.

applies_to.description: For procedure publication, choose exactly [user], [project], [machine], or [project, machine]. Omit during the authoring request.

use_when.description: One sentence describing when to use this procedure.

instructions.description: Complete instruction-only procedure, coherently rewritten rather than appended.

evidence.description: Record observations, user corrections or decisions, and verification supporting this update. Preserve new occurrences, conditions, and supporting evidence even when the conclusion is unchanged. Distinguish observations from hypotheses.

procedure.description: remember_this learned procedure only; never combine with memories or pending work. First submit operation and evidence_memory_ids, plus parent_refs for evolve, to obtain authoring_ref. Then submit that authoring_ref with operation, evidence_memory_ids, name, use_when, instructions and evidence; create also requires applies_to, evolve requires parent_refs. Follow the returned authoring guidance.

authoring_ref.description: remember_this procedure publication only. Copy the returned authoring reference; submit it with the completed procedure, not memories.

memory_id.description: history only. Copy a known memory ID. Supply exactly one of memory_id or procedure_id.

procedure_id.description: history only. Copy a known learned procedure ID. Supply exactly one of memory_id or procedure_id.

context_layers.description: history only. Nonnegative ancestor-context depth for recent history or history_for search. Use 0 for no additional ancestor context. Do not combine with start_change_id/end_change_id.

history_for.description: history only. Describe the past change to find within the selected memory/procedure. Requires context_layers and positive max_matches; do not combine with exact range fields.

max_matches.description: history only. Positive maximum search matches; requires history_for and context_layers. Do not use for recent history or exact ranges.

start_change_id.description: history only. Copy a returned change ID for the inclusive range start; requires end_change_id. Omit context_layers, history_for and max_matches for exact ranges.

end_change_id.description: history only. Copy a returned change ID for the inclusive range end; requires start_change_id.

project_path.description: Verified absolute root of the project being worked on, not Agentlaw's process cwd. Required for connect_project_memory; supported for recall and new/continued remember_this work.

intent.description: connect_project_memory only. discover returns candidates without binding (default). connect requires a user-selected project_id. create requires project_name and confirmed first-time adoption; no candidates alone is not permission to create.

repository_url.description: Only an observed repository URL, not Agentlaw's or the memory store's remote.

project_id.description: connect_project_memory with intent=connect only. Copy the candidate ID explicitly selected by the user, even for one candidate.

project_name.description: connect_project_memory with intent=create only. Required name for a confirmed new project identity.

project_description.description: connect_project_memory with intent=create only. Optional description of the new project identity.

memory_store_path.description: connect_project_memory only. Verified existing local memory store path. Does not authorize switching away from another selected store.

restore_context.description: recall or connect_project_memory only. Set true when project context is missing or incomplete. Requires recall_for; omit for ID-only or focused follow-up.

recall_for.description: For recall, describe the current task/question and new observations; omit for ID-only lookup. For connect_project_memory, supply together with restore_context=true to recall after connecting.

title: Agentlaw action inputs
description: Set action and supply exactly the same-named object, e.g. {"action":"recall","recall":{"recall_for":"Current work"}}. Never mix action objects.
